source_provenance: Yu-Han Tseng and Bo-Nian Chen (2026), Chinese Chess Practical Dataset (CCPD), https://github.com/Yvonne761/Chinese-Chess-Practical-Dataset, CC BY 4.0. Pinned revision 368a47a947773dd8692c026e286dd19b6277b993. First 256 master-game entries ordered by SHA256(qi-benchmark-book-v1: + path) among the 53685 master-game files returned by the pinned truncated tree; not a full-dataset sample.
selection: Exclude 12 active optimization families, retain first entry per remaining family, sort by SHA256(tb3-br006-v1: + family); 8 public, 8 author validation, 32 grading. Selected before any match outcome.
exposure: Repartition of Qi development inputs, not a fresh Qi locked pool or certified training-disjoint data. Grading families are withheld from the fresh agent package.
